ERROR_rule_tooling_disagreement.severity: decision-blocking, logged loudly per the NO-SILENT-FALLBACKS rule (2026-08-06)
ERROR_rule_tooling_disagreement.rule: C37 arming check: 'Size <= 20% of the trailing 10 completed minutes' volume.'
ERROR_rule_tooling_disagreement.disagreement: plan/bars_paste.py reports trail10vol=1,307 -> cap20%=261 sh. It sums the last 10 STORED bars, and because interpolated bars are (correctly) never stored, those 10 bars span 04:01-07:58 ET -- 4 hours, not 10 minutes. Read as WALL CLOCK, VICR printed ZERO shares in 08:15-08:25 ET (last real print 11:58Z/07:58 ET), so the cap is 0 sh.
ERROR_rule_tooling_disagreement.magnitude: The two readings differ by ~25x on the same name at the same instant, and they straddle the 72-share ticket: 261 >= 72 would arm, 0 < 72 refuses.
ERROR_rule_tooling_disagreement.other_gates_at_this_moment: ALL PASSED -- halal PASS, coil 0.992, calm-gap yes, spread 0.485% (inside the 0.5% cap for the first time today), depth 134 sh within trigger*1.005 vs 72 needed, and fill-arming satisfied (trigger 206.92 > ask 206.50, so the stop was not already met). The size rule was the only thing standing between this and an armed premarket ticket.
ERROR_rule_tooling_disagreement.decision: DID NOT ARM. Took the conservative branch: a name that has not printed a single share in 27 minutes is not one where a 72-share ticket is 20% of anything. The skill's own asymmetry governs -- 'an unfilled exit is dangerous, an unfilled entry is merely a missed opportunity' -- and premarket legs are the documented loss centre (-$112,494 over 691 legs). VICR stays latched and is re-evaluated at the open, where the rule is unambiguous.
ERROR_rule_tooling_disagreement.needs_user_ruling: Which window does trail10vol mean -- last 10 stored bars (current code) or last 10 wall-clock minutes (the rule's words)? On a premarket-dark name these are wildly different, and the current code is the permissive one. This is a live-vs-backtest parity question, not a style preference.

fake_gap_finding.why_it_matters: The scan's changeFromCloseAllDayRatio carries a PRIOR-day extended-hours print when a name has not traded in the current session, so a name can sit on the +10% scan all morning having never moved today. RH's minute feed returned 0 real bars and 182 interpolated ones, and the ranker refused it as NO BARS -- the mechanical path caught it independently.
